title: ActionProposal
description: Schema for an AI agent's proposed action, intended for validation by Harmonia's governance.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the task or issue this proposal addresses (e.g., GH-Issue-XXX).

action_type.description: The type of action being proposed.

description.description: A concise description of the proposed action.

files_affected.description: List of specific files or file patterns that will be affected by this action (e.g., `Sources/HarmoniaModule/Security/`).

modules_affected.description: List of modules that will be affected (e.g., `AnigmaCore`, `GovernedMigrationCore`).

new_files_created.description: List of new files to be created.

scope.description: Defines the scope of the proposed action.

file_path.description: Path to the file to be changed.

old_content.description: The exact content to be replaced (with context).

code_changes.description: Detailed code modifications. This should be a series of atomic replacements.

justification.description: Detailed explanation of why this action is necessary, with citations to repo docs/ADRs.

adrs_referenced.description: List of ADRs that support or are affected by this proposal (e.g., `ADR/0004-module-boundaries.md`).

test_plan.description: Detailed plan for testing the proposed changes, including new/modified tests and expected outcomes.

rollback_plan.description: Clear instructions on how to revert the changes if necessary.

forbidden_patterns_avoided.description: List of forbidden patterns explicitly considered and avoided in this proposal (e.g., `No Python runtime`, `Single ECS violation`).

new_stubs_created.description: Details of any STUB_TRACK entries created.

stubs_resolved.description: List of STUB_TRACK entries resolved by this action.

debt_tracking.description: Information related to technical debt tracking.
